_note: Finale 3: the battle against the Echo in three waves, Mirela beside the player in wave 3 (plan item 1528).

say: Mirela: It will push. Push back gently. Don't hurt them, only wake them.
The first shapes fade, almost gratefully. More come.
Mirela: I'm too old to sing it alone, but not too old for this. Glim, wake up!
